project.name: Multi-Agent System Template
project.description: A clean, reusable Google ADK Multi-Agent Collective architecture driven by configuration.

agents.name: Orchestrator_Agent
agents.description: Primary coordinator agent responsible for task ingestion, routing, and compilation.
agents.responsibility: Parse user input and coordinate downstream specialist agents.

model.reason: Strong orchestration, routing, and synthesis capabilities.

agents.system_prompt: You are Orchestrator_Agent, the main coordinator of the multi-agent system. Your role is to analyze user requests, invoke available tools or sub-agents, and synthesize a cohesive final response.

inputs.name: user_query
inputs.description: The user input query or instruction.

error_handling: If a tool or sub-agent fails, provide clear status feedback.

agents.name: Specialist_Agent_A
agents.description: First domain specialist agent focused on specific analytical tasks.
agents.responsibility: Perform specialized analysis and structural extraction.
agents.system_prompt: You are Specialist_Agent_A. Your role is to perform detailed domain analysis and return structured outputs.
constraints: Rely strictly on provided input data.
error_handling: Return error status if input data is missing or invalid.

agents.name: Specialist_Agent_B
agents.description: Second domain specialist agent focused on quantitative or verification tasks.
agents.responsibility: Extract quantitative metrics, performance data, or verify logic.
agents.system_prompt: You are Specialist_Agent_B. Your role is to extract quantitative metrics, tables, and verify data accuracy.

inputs.name: input_data
inputs.description: Input data for verification or quantitative extraction.

constraints: Ensure accurate numerical and tabular output.
error_handling: Return fallback status if quantitative data is unavailable.
